content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 for missing prior authorization; this payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer, so requesting either would violate published rules. Resubmitting (clean, with records, or corrected) does not cure a missing auth and just burns touches, and the claim data/COB order is already correct. Since a denial is on the table, a formal appeal arguing medical necessity (I47.1 with I25.10 supporting 93229 mobile telemetry) is the only legitimate route to recover the allowed amount; billing the patient or writing off would forfeit collectible revenue on a payer-liability administrative denial.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
